description:
Take a spin around Hotel del Coronado's iconic beachfront ice rink, where sparkling holiday memories meet breathtaking Pacific views. Skating by the Sea® is a one-of-a-kind winter tradition that brings the magic of the season to Southern California's coast.

A portion of the proceeds benefits Make-A-Wish® San Diego.
what_is_included: 90 minutes of ice skating, including skate rental.
special_requirements: All skaters must sign a waiver (parent/guardian signature if under 18).

faqs:
##Where can I purchase tickets? Can I buy a ticket on-site?##
Tickets must be purchased online or by phone and waivers signed before you approach the check-in window. Your reservation is only valid for the time(s) and date(s) purchased. Tickets may be purchased on-site with your phone, but quantities are limited. To ensure you are able to get tickets for your desired time, please purchase your tickets in advance.

##Do you offer individual or group discounts on tickets?##
Please check back later for information on group skating tickets.

##Are skates included in the price?##
Yes, skate rentals are included.

##How long can I skate?##
Tickets are valid for 90 minutes of ice skating, which begins at the time of check-in. Your reservation is only valid for the time(s) and date(s) purchased. Check-in will be allowed up to 20 minutes after the scheduled check-in time.

##Where is the ice rink located?##
The ice rink is located on the beachfront Windsor Lawn at the Hotel del Coronado, at 1500 Orange Avenue, Coronado, CA, 92118.

##Is parking included or validated with ice skating?##
No. Standard parking rates apply. Shop or dine at the resort to receive $10 off self-parking for day visitors.

##What is the smallest/largest skate size?##
We have skates from Toddler size 8 to Adult size 15. We do offer double-runners for young children sizes Toddler 8 to Youth 12.

##How old does a child need to be to ice skate?##
There is no age restriction; however, we do not offer refunds for small children who decide not to skate. We do ask that anyone under the age of 12 be accompanied by a skating adult. 
PLEASE NOTE: SHOES ARE NOT PERMITTED ON THE ICE. PARENTS ARE NOT ALLOWED TO CARRY CHILDREN WHILE SKATING.

##Can I use my ticket on a different day?##
No, your ticket is non-transferable to another day, or to another person.

##What if I buy a ticket and the weather is unfavorable?##
Weather conditions, such as wind or strong sun exposure, can affect ice quality. We continue to skate in light rain or drizzle. If heavy rain or severe storm conditions result in a venue closure, relevant tickets will be rescheduled or refunded.

##Do I need to wear socks?##
Yes.

##Can I bring my own ice skates?##
Yes. However, those with their own skates pay the same admission price as others.

##If I bring my own skates, do you offer skate-sharpening services?##
No, we do not offer sharpening services.

##Can I wear my shoes on the ice?##
No. It is your responsibility to ensure that before entering the skating surface, you are wearing skates that are properly and securely fastened to your feet.

##Can I have a stroller on the ice?##
No. A stroller is not designed for use on the ice.

##Do I need to wear a helmet?##
It is a recognized fact that helmets may protect skaters from potential head injuries, especially when there is a risk of impact. Skating by the Sea at Hotel del Coronado recommends that every skater wear a helmet. However, we do not rent or provide helmets. Skating involves risks. The decision to wear a helmet should be made by the skater at the time they decide to come to the rink. Just as they decide whether to bring a jacket or gloves, they need to decide if a helmet is needed.

##Do you offer skate aids for toddlers?##
No. Instead, we offer "double-runner" skates for toddlers in sizes J8 to J12 (Toddler shoe sizes 8 to 12) for added stability.

##Is the ice rink ADA-accessible?##
Absolutely! Our ice rink is ADA-compliant.

##Are wheelchairs allowed on the ice?##
Yes, we allow and encourage wheelchairs on the ice. Please ask a Guest Service member for assistance.
